eip_proposals_multidimensional_fee.highlight: EIP-7999 unified max fee: replace per-resource max fees with single fungible max fee; reduces stale-tx exclusion risk
State limit in bytes (not gas) proposed: safe across repricing, simpler for wallets, converted to gas at processing time
EVM gas accounting options: aggregate gas, sub-fee accounting, or full multidimensional with universal overflow channel — 6 total combinations under consideration
L2 interest (Base): unified max fee useful today — L1 data fee is multidimensional but users currently cannot set a limit
